items.action: Patch Cisco Secure Email Gateway to 15.5.5-014, 16.0.4-302, or 16.5.0-780; check mail_logs for suspicious SQL (e.g. COPY ... TO PROGRAM) for signs of exploitation.
items.details: The flaw can be triggered by sending a specially crafted email through a vulnerable gateway; no authentication or admin-interface access is required.
items.summary: Unauthenticated SQL injection in Cisco Secure Email Gateway's AsyncOS software lets a remote attacker execute arbitrary commands with root privileges via a crafted email. Cisco confirms active exploitation in September 2026, and the CVE is on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
items.title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway CVE-2026-76461 exploited in the wild

items.action: Update macOS to the patched versions; block inbound access to port 5900 at the firewall and disable Screen Sharing if it isn't needed. Note: updating does not clean up an existing compromise.
items.details: The vulnerability requires no valid username or password, so account hardening alone does not protect exposed hosts.
items.summary: CVE-2026-65400 is a remote code execution flaw in the macOS Screen Sharing service (TCP port 5900) that needs no credentials and is reportedly being actively exploited against internet-facing Macs.
items.title: Actively exploited macOS Screen Sharing RCE (CVE-2026-65400)

items.action: Update to Codex Desktop build 26.818.21641 and Codex CLI 0.149.0 or later; treat unfamiliar or third-party repositories as untrusted input.
items.details: Both bugs shared a root cause: the enforcement mechanism lived inside the code it was meant to restrain. The more serious flaw, Heapjack, extracted a trusted-context token from shared memory and worked in the strictest read-only mode.
items.summary: Researchers at Accomplish AI found two sandbox escapes in OpenAI's Codex coding agent ('Heapjack' and 'Overpatch') that allowed unsandboxed host command execution from a malicious repo, with no approval prompt or on-screen indication. Reported August 12; OpenAI patched within eight days.
items.title: OpenAI Codex sandbox escapes allowed host RCE from malicious repos

items.action: Update any web apps or plugins using the getID3 library to the patched release and scan for exploitation of upload/media-processing paths.
items.details: getID3 is a widely used PHP library for extracting metadata from media files, so any application accepting media uploads is exposed.
items.summary: CVE-2026-94106 is an OS command injection in the getID3 PHP media-processing library, reachable via malicious filenames. CVSS 8.8, disclosed September 21, 2026.
items.title: getID3 library CVE-2026-94106 — CVSS 8.8 OS command injection

items.details: Both companies are publicly traded and large-scale: Flex is a global manufacturing and supply-chain company operating in ~30 countries; Bruker makes scientific and analytical instruments. No data-exfiltration or encryption details have been independently confirmed.
items.summary: The MetaEncryptor ransomware operation listed Flex Ltd and Bruker Corporation on September 21, 2026, visible across multiple ransomware-monitoring datasets. Treat as a claim, not a confirmed breach.
items.title: MetaEncryptor lists Flex Ltd and Bruker Corporation

items.details: TruAmerica describes itself as a vertically integrated residential investment manager with a nationally distributed multifamily portfolio. No confirmation from the company was located.
items.summary: The Termite ransomware group claimed TruAmerica Multifamily, a Los Angeles-based real-estate investment and asset-management firm, citing unauthorized system access and operational disruption. The claim is unverified.
items.title: Termite claims TruAmerica Multifamily

items.details: Newman Tractor (sales, rentals, parts, and service in Kentucky, Ohio, and Florida) has not publicly confirmed the incident; monitoring sources describe it as an unverified ransomware claim.
items.summary: The 3AM ransomware group listed newmantractor.com as a claimed victim on September 21, 2026, targeting the heavy-equipment dealer. No independent confirmation of compromise or data theft exists.
items.title: 3AM ransomware claims Newman Tractor

items.action: Scan for the FLATROOF/ROOFDECK indicators and hunt for the fake job-interview repos (gtn-candidate-repo, Northwind-IAC, novacart-interview, terraform-candidate-repo) and rogue Terraform registry domains; block execution of terraform init from untrusted projects.
items.details: FLATROOF uses Telegram for C2; ROOFDECK uses the decentralized Nostr protocol. The implants sat dormant on disk from March 18 until a Cursor workspace opened on March 29 triggered execution. The same backdoors were previously seen in the March-April 2026 KelpDAO LayerZero bridge attack.
items.summary: SentinelOne attributed the compromise of an India-based IT services provider to the North Korea-linked Jade Sleet actor (TraderTraitor/UNC4899). The campaign used fake DevOps job-interview GitHub repos with weaponized Terraform lock files to drop the Rust-based macOS backdoors FLATROOF and ROOFDECK on an Apple Silicon MacBook belonging to a DevOps engineer.
items.title: Jade Sleet breaches Indian IT provider with macOS backdoors

items.action: Update Chrome immediately on all platforms (Linux, Windows, macOS); the update closes the listed flaws, including type-confusion and use-after-free issues in V8 and WebXR.
items.details: CERT-In says the flaws could enable complete system compromise, data theft, and ransomware or spyware deployment, given Chrome's widespread use across Indian government, enterprise, and consumer devices.
items.summary: CERT-In issued a high-risk advisory for Google Chrome users after multiple severe vulnerabilities — type confusion and use-after-free in V8, object-lifecycle issues in Media, incorrect security UI — were found in versions prior to 142.0.7444.59/60.
items.title: CERT-In warns of high-risk vulnerabilities in Google Chrome
